svg.title: The curve y cubed minus x y equals 6
svg.desc: The graph of the curve y cubed minus x y = 6 on axes with x from minus 2 to 14 and y from minus 4 to 4. It has two pieces: an upper piece rising through (1, 2) and (7, 3), and a lower piece below the x-axis. The curve never meets the x-axis. The points (1, 2) and (7, 3) are marked.
svg.text: the x-axis; it never meets it.
